entry.name: Source
entry.label: Absolute file path or URL of the wallpaper

entry.name: Kind
entry.label: Wallpaper kind: video, gif, picture, web, url, videostream or none

entry.name: CoreSocket
entry.label: WebSocket URL of the Lively core (ws://127.0.0.1:port)

entry.name: Instance
entry.label: Instance id, echoed in the WebSocket path /wallpaper/<instance>

entry.name: Scaler
entry.label: Scaling mode: none, fill, uniform or uniformFill

entry.name: Interactive
entry.label: Whether the web view receives pointer input

entry.name: SpanX
entry.label: Span mode: x of this desktop's slice inside the virtual screen

entry.name: SpanY
entry.label: Span mode: y of this desktop's slice inside the virtual screen

entry.name: SpanWidth
entry.label: Span mode: width of this desktop's slice inside the virtual screen

entry.name: SpanHeight
entry.label: Span mode: height of this desktop's slice inside the virtual screen

entry.name: SpanVirtualWidth
entry.label: Span mode: width of the virtual screen the wallpaper is stretched over (0 disables span mode)

entry.name: SpanVirtualHeight
entry.label: Span mode: height of the virtual screen the wallpaper is stretched over (0 disables span mode)

entry.name: FillColor
entry.label: Color shown behind the wallpaper and when Kind is none
